belief.answer: The exact set \(\mathcal G\) is not currently known; deciding whether it is empty is equivalent to the open monotone sequential completeness problem for finite \(\mathrm{AW}^*\)-factors.

options.approach: Audit the precise structural theorem needed for monotone sequential completeness, distinguishing it from projection completeness and from von Neumann algebra results. Check whether its hypotheses follow from the definition in the problem.
